tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The first background tone of the deck (cover, roles, features, paystub).

tokens.name: paper-alt
tokens.usage: Second background tone, and the fill of muted cards that sit on paper (the role cards).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces that hold numbers, like the paystub card. Pair with a line-soft border and shadow-card.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty tracks and inactive fills (timeline bars, disabled buttons). Body text on it is ink or ink-soft; ink-muted is only 4.35:1 here in light, so keep it to 24px and up.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairline rules between rows. Decorative only, never the only thing that tells two controls apart.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Borders of raised cards and the dividers inside them.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, primary text, 2px group rules, button and pill strokes, the filled current StatusPill. Reads on paper, paper-alt, card and track in both themes (12.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Running text, leads and deduction amounts on paper, paper-alt, card and track (7.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, eyebrows, notes, footers and page numbers on paper, paper-alt and card (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Arrows, connectors, dashed outlines of external systems and the cover pattern. Not for text. 3.6:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill, like the primary Button label and the current StatusPill.

tokens.name: tile-top
tokens.usage: Top-left stop of the brand tile gradient (the app icon and the 42% statement slide). Dark lifts it so the tile stays visible on dark paper.

tokens.name: tile-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom-right stop of the brand tile gradient. Run the gradient at 135deg from tile-top.

tokens.name: on-tile
tokens.usage: Big figures and headings on the tile gradient (5.9:1 or more across the whole gradient).

tokens.name: on-tile-soft
tokens.usage: The supporting line under a figure on the tile gradient (4.7:1 or more).

groups.name: Product display
groups.note: MuseoModerno for headings, figures and totals in the app. Never for running text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The wordmark and one hero line per screen.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A single big amount, like take-home pay on a dashboard. Tabular figures.

styles.name: total
styles.usage: The total row of a paystub or summary.

groups.name: Product text
groups.note: Sen for everything that is read.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Every line explained, and ready to preview a few days before payday.
styles.usage: The one sentence under a page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Prepares payroll. Can't approve it or edit their own pay.
styles.usage: Running text, table cells, form fields.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The one row that matters in a list, and button labels (at 600).

styles.name: note
styles.usage: The plain-language reason under a paystub line, and helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and column headers, set in uppercase in ink-muted.

groups.name: Slides
groups.note: The exact sizes from the Forté deck, on its 1920 by 1080 canvas.

styles.name: slide-stat
styles.usage: One number on a tile-gradient statement slide.

styles.name: slide-heading
styles.usage: The heading at the top margin of every content slide.

styles.name: slide-lead
styles.usage: Taglines, row values and the big line of a two-column row.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: Approved runs lock. Mistakes get fixed with a new run.

styles.name: slide-caption
styles.usage: Footers, page numbers, diagram labels. Never smaller.

styles.name: slide-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headings and columns, in ink-muted.

spacing.note: 4px base. Slides use the same steps doubled, with a 128px margin.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its note.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label, inside small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between paystub lines and other related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button side padding (small), gaps between pills.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between cards, button side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding; the slide footer's distance from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: space-slide
tokens.usage: Slide margins on the 1920 by 1080 canvas.

radius.note: Generous and soft. Slides use each value doubled.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and diagram boxes (24px on slides).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards (32px on slides).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The paystub card and other raised number cards (40px on slides).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The icon's shape. Round only the top-right and bottom-left corners at 22% of the side and leave the other two square. Brand tiles only, never UI cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and status pills.

shadow.note: One elevation. Prefer rules and fills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The paystub and other raised number cards. Nothing else floats.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control. A 2px paper gap, then 2px of solid ink, as a box-shadow so it follows the radius.
